text:
Maria L.: Quick update — we turned on the new store-frontier cache coordinator in the g5.2x canary earlier this morning. Initial perf runs show median generation latency down ~18% and p99 down ~23% for our chat workloads (seq len ~512). :tada:

Ajay P.: awesome. is that with the new lease expiry heuristic enabled or just the eviction window change?

Maria L.: both. coordinator lock hold time reduced, and the lease expiry heuristic avoids unnecessary rewarm for short-lived prefixes. config diff: 
```yaml
cache_coordinator:
  lease_expiry_ms: 1200  # reduced from 5000
  rewarm_threshold_ms: 40
  eviction_window_ms: 30000
```

Kevin R.: can we get the absolute numbers for tokens/sec and cost impact?

Maria L.: sure, on canary (200 RPS synthetic):
- tokens/sec +21% throughput
- average GPU utilization +6% (more sustained vs spikes)
- estimated token cost down ~12% due to fewer cold KV loads and smaller per-request steady-state work

Olivia S.: did you see any regressions on long-context tails (2k+)?

Maria L.: small p50 increase (~3%) on 2k runs due to extra coordinator RPCs in the hottest paths; p99 still improved overall. we're iterating — Garrett has a patch to batch coordinator RPCs for >1k sequences.

Garrett T.: ^ that patch is up: I added microbatching for coordinator lookups when request batch size > 8. simple change, no model runtime touch. local perf: p99 on 2k down 12% vs previous coordinator. planning canary in next slot.

infra-bot: deploy-canary: component=store-coordinator status=started target=g5-2x-canary id=deploy-2026-04-12-09:15:23

Ajay P.: any ops changes? alerts?

Maria L.: yes — new alerts: coordinator-latency.p95 > 120ms for 5m, and coordinator-rpc-error-rate > 0.5% for 5m. Docs update in #eng-runtime-docs after canary pass.

Kevin R.: cool. schedule a short sync with SRE to review fallback strategy (we should ensure graceful fallback to per-worker local cache if coordinator unavailable).

Maria L.: agreed. propose Wed 10am for a 30 min sync. I'll DM calendar invites. Thanks everyone — will post full bench logs in the thread once canary finishes. :rocket:
